name: field
title: Field
description: An animated form field for React and shadcn, with a label, a control and one line for help or errors.

meta.details: Label, control and one message line on Base UI Field. The description and the error share the line and swap with y + blur; inside Base UI's Form, submitting focuses the first invalid field.

docs: Import Field from components/eased/field/field and put an Input, Textarea or Search Field inside. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import.
